press-banca.cue: Shoulder blades together and down, feet planted. Lower to the bottom of your chest with elbows at about 45°.

press-banca-ligero.cue: Same technique as the bench press. Finish with about 3 reps left in the tank.

press-banca-mancuernas.cue: Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest under control and press them together at the top without clashing them.

press-pecho-maquina.cue: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height. Press without lifting your back off the pad.

press-inclinado.cue: Bench at 30–45°. Shoulder blades together; lower to chest height.

press-inclinado-barra.cue: Bench at 30–45°. Lower the bar to your upper chest, elbows at about 45°.

aperturas.cue: Arms slightly bent and locked in place, as if hugging a tree.

aperturas-mancuernas.cue: Elbows slightly bent; open until you feel a stretch in your chest, without going too low.

cruce-poleas.cue: Step forward, arms slightly bent; bring your hands together in front of your chest and squeeze for 1 second.

flexiones.cue: Body in a straight line, hands a little wider than your shoulders; chest close to the floor.

fondos.cue: Lean your torso forward and lower until your shoulders are level with your elbows.

jalon-amplio.cue: Chest up; pull the bar to your upper chest driving with your elbows. No swinging.

jalon-estrecho.cue: Hands closer together: drive your elbows toward your ribs.

jalon-v.cue: Palms facing each other; pull the handle to your chest leaning back just slightly.

dominadas.cue: From straight arms, pull up until your chin clears the bar; lower under control.

remo-mancuerna.cue: Back straight and parallel to the floor; pull the dumbbell toward your hip. Reps per arm.

remo-maquina.cue: Chest up; drive your elbows back and squeeze your back for 1 second.

remo-barra.cue: Torso leaning about 45°, back straight; pull the bar to your belly button.

remo-t.cue: Chest up and back straight; pull with your elbows close to your body.

pullover-polea.cue: Arms almost straight; bring the bar down to your thighs in an arc.

press-hombro.cue: Back against the pad; lower until your hands are at ear height.

press-hombro-mancuernas.cue: Seated with back support; press up without arching your lower back.

press-militar.cue: Standing, glutes and abs tight; press the bar in a straight line overhead.

laterales.cue: Raise to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent, no momentum.

laterales-polea.cue: The cable keeps tension at the bottom; raise to shoulder height under control.

face-pull.cue: Rope at face height; pull toward your ears, spreading your hands apart.

pajaros.cue: Bent forward, open your arms out to the sides with elbows slightly bent.

posterior-polea.cue: Cross the cables and open backward at shoulder height.

curl-mancuerna.cue: Elbows still and close to your body. Lower slowly, 2–3 seconds.

curl-polea.cue: Elbows still; the cable keeps tension through the whole range.

curl-barra.cue: Elbows close to your body; curl without swinging your back.

curl-predicador.cue: Arms resting on the pad; lower almost to full extension without locking the elbow.

curl-inclinado.cue: Seated on an incline bench, arms hanging back; a big stretch for the biceps.

curl-martillo.cue: Palms facing each other, elbows still.

triceps-polea.cue: Elbows fixed at your sides; only your forearms move.

triceps-cuerda.cue: At the bottom, pull the rope ends apart and outward.

triceps-cabeza.cue: Facing away from the cable, elbows forward; stretch well back.

press-frances.cue: Lying down, lower the bar toward your forehead moving only at the elbows.

patada-triceps.cue: Elbow tucked in and fixed; extend your arm fully backward.

press-cerrado.cue: Hands shoulder-width apart, elbows tucked; lower to the bottom of your chest.

fondos-banco.cue: Hands on the bench behind you; lower by bending your elbows backward.

goblet.cue: Dumbbell held against your chest; knees tracking over your toes; thighs parallel or lower.

smith.cue: Knees tracking over your toes, back straight; lower to parallel.

sentadilla.cue: Bar on your upper traps, chest up; lower to parallel or below with a neutral back.

hack.cue: Back against the pad; go deep without lifting your heels.

prensa.cue: Your hips never leave the seat. Don’t lock your knees at the top.

extension.cue: Squeeze for 1 second at the top. No jerking or momentum.

zancadas.cue: Long step, torso upright; your back knee almost touches the floor. Reps per leg.

zancadas-mancuernas.cue: Dumbbells at your sides; long step and torso upright. Reps per leg.

bulgara.cue: Back foot on a bench; lower straight down with your torso leaning slightly forward. Reps per leg.

curl-femoral.cue: Hips pressed into the bench; curl up under control and lower slowly.

curl-femoral-sentado.cue: Set the pad over your ankles; curl all the way and return slowly.

rdl-mancuernas.cue: Hips back, back straight, knees just slightly bent.

rdl-barra.cue: Bar close to your legs the whole way. If your back rounds, lower the weight.

peso-muerto.cue: Bar against your shins, neutral back; push the floor away with your legs.

hip-thrust.cue: Upper back on the bench; drive your hips up squeezing your glutes and look ahead.

puente-gluteo.cue: Lying on the floor; drive your hips up squeezing your glutes for 1 second at the top.

pantorrilla.cue: Lower to a full stretch and pause 1 second at the bottom. No bouncing.

pantorrilla-sentado.cue: Knees under the pad; rise as high as you can and stretch well at the bottom.

crunch-polea.cue: Round your back bringing your chest toward your knees. Your hips don’t move.

crunch.cue: Lift only your shoulders off the floor squeezing your abs; don’t pull on your neck.

plancha.cue: Body in a straight line, glutes squeezed, without letting your hips sag.

rueda.cue: From your knees, roll forward with your abs tight without arching your back.

elev-piernas.cue: Lower back pressed into the floor or bench. Lower slowly.

elev-colgado.cue: Hanging from the bar, raise your legs without swinging.

vol5.name: Volume · 5 days
vol5.desc: Upper/Lower twice + one light full-body day. Lots of volume to grow.

vol4.name: Volume · 4 days
vol4.desc: Upper / Lower twice a week. A great balance of volume and rest; ideal for heavy work weeks.

full3.name: Full body · 3 days
full3.desc: The whole body every session. Perfect for getting started or for weeks when you can only go 3 days.

def4.name: Cut · 4 days
def4.desc: Keep the main lifts heavy to hold on to muscle; accessories with more reps and short rests. Fat is lost mostly through diet (eating a little less than you burn) and walking more.

fuerza4.name: Strength · 4 days
fuerza4.desc: Barbell basics at low reps with long rests. It demands good technique: do it once you’ve mastered the squat, press and deadlift.

ppl6.name: Push / Pull / Legs · 6 days
ppl6.desc: Every muscle twice a week with lots of volume. Very demanding: only if you sleep well and your job lets you recover.
